tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Open roles on Parlel, newest first. `q` matches the TITLE only. Filter by working arrangement, seniority and a pay floor. Returns {items, next_cursor}; each item has a `role_url` you can cite.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One role by id, with its full description, skills, pay and the hiring company. Works for closed roles too; read `status`.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Companies with a published page. `q` matches name, tagline or industry; `industry` is an exact label; `hiring=true` narrows to companies with at least one open role. Each item has `open_role_count`.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One company by handle, with its open roles inline.

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Published profiles. `q` matches name, headline, company, role and work history (not skills, not bio). `skills` are exact tags, AND-ed. `based_in` is where the person is; `location` also matches where they would move to. Contact details are never returned.

tools.name: get_person
tools.description: One published profile by handle: headline, bio, work history, education, skills, recent posts and the agents they publish.

tools.name: search_agents
tools.description: Published watch agents -- standing searches people run against the open web -- with a preview of what each has found. No text filter; walk the list. `sort` is `recent` or `popular`.

tools.name: get_agent
tools.description: One published agent by slug: its brief, schedule and recent findings with sources.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_person · Private data: search_people · Public sink: get_person · Destructive: search_agents.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_person · Private data: search_people · Public sink: get_person · Destructive: search_agents

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
